title: Kiro IDE: observed workspace JSON subset
description: Permissive subset of the IDE workspace-session objects accepted by continues. This is not the ordinary Kiro CLI SQLite store. This is a partial observational reference, not a vendor-certified or lossless ingestion schema. Unknown properties are allowed.
